## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, handsome lad with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and broad shoulders. As a young student, he was known for a teasing smile and a frank, straightforward expression. Following an intense academic term at Redmond College, he temporarily appeared pale and thin.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 c39 P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022)_

## Personality

Gilbert is clever, hard-working, and driven by a strong determination to get the best out of life and put the best into it. Good-natured and possessing a keen sense of humor, he enjoys harmless teasing but is also capable of profound thoughtfulness and self-sacrifice. He shows great ambition in his academic pursuits and sports leadership while maintaining deep loyalty, patience, and honor in his personal friendships and romance.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## History

Gilbert Blythe returned to Avonlea after spending three years in Alberta with his father. Upon re-entering school, he entered a intense, friendly academic rivalry with Anne Shirley. After attending Queen's Academy together and taking the Second Year work in one year, Gilbert took a job teaching at White Sands to earn money for college, graciously giving up the Avonlea school post to Anne. In Avonlea, he co-founded and served as president of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society.

Gilbert later attended Redmond College alongside Anne. There, he led the Freshmen to victory in the Arts Rush, was elected Freshman Class President, and became Captain of the Freshman football team. During his sophomore year, he confessed his love to Anne, but she rejected his marriage proposal. Afterwards, he maintained a courteous distance while working during summers at the Daily News office. He later escorted Christine Stuart at the request of her brother, sparking college rumors of an engagement. After graduating with High Honors in Classics and winning the Cooper Prize, Gilbert suffered a severe case of typhoid fever from overwork, but safely recovered, ultimately reconciling with Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c7 P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c6 P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 c20 P23](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0023), [v3 c20 P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 c25 P25](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0025), [v3 c39 P23](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0023), [v3 c40 P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v3 c40 P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025), [v3 c41 P29](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0029)_

## Background by volume

- spent three years living in Alberta with his sick father, missing much school  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- spent a summer visiting cousins in New Brunswick before returning to Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- fell in love with Anne Shirley after she broke her slate over his head  <sub>[v3 c41 P29](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0029)</sub>
- gave up teaching the Avonlea school to let Anne stay close to Marilla  <sub>[v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
